€1P. (फुल्लति, फुल्लित) 
__1 To bloom, expand, blow, open (as a flower). 
__2 To swell, expand; निष्पीडनस्फारफुल्लत्फणापीठः [[

p. p. (of फुल्ल्) 
__1 Expanded, opened, blown, पुष्पं च फुल्लं नवमल्लिकायाः प्रयाति कान्ति प्रमदाजनानाम् [[

.]] 
__3 Expanded, dilated, wide opened (as eyes). 
__4 Smiling, gay. 
__5 Puffed, inflated (as cheeks). 
__6 Loose (as a garment). 
-ल्लम् A full-blown flower. 
-Comp. 
-तुवरी alum. 
-दामन् n. a kind of metre. 
-नयन, -नेत्र, -लोचन a. having eyes dilated (with joy); वीक्षन्तेऽन्यमितः स्फुटत्कुमुदिनीफुल्लोल्लसल्लोचनाः [[

.]] 
(-नः) a kind of deer. 
(-नम्) a large, full eye. 
-फालः the wind raised in winnowing corn. 
-वदन a. looking pleased or happy.

(also फुल्तिः) f. 
__1 Blossoming, blooming. 
__2 Perfection, fullness.
